svg.title: Registered trials per strategy category, ledger of 21 October 2026
svg.desc: Horizontal bar chart of registered strategy cells (trials) per category, coloured by verdict. Killed: microstructure and order book 36, event-driven 34, tree-based machine learning 16 plus 16 charged from diagnostics, momentum, trend and flow 20, mean reversion 18, volatility and regime overlays 6. Passed as a cost saving: maker-peg execution 10. Inconclusive or void: transformers 8. Passed, downgraded: the survivor chain, 6 plus 1 charged. Pairs and stat-arb, arbitrage and lead-lag, and carry have no registered trials. In all, 154 registered and 17 charged; the estimated 1,700 earlier configurations are not drawn.
